column5: generate_qtl_sumstats -> qtl_sumstats_construct.R: QtlSumStats for test_study/context1/ENSG00000283047 (200 variants of the gene's cis window, filtered out of the 16-gene TensorQTL nominal table by molecular_trait_id) with the qtl_mini genotypes attached as the ldSketch and summaryStatsQc applied. Deterministic (no RNG); byte-identical across two runs. normalize_paths: the ldSketch embeds the genotype path, basename-normalized by rds_compare.R.

qtl_rss_fine_mapping -> fine_mapping.R --qtl-sumstats: QtlFineMappingResult from susieR::susie_rss over the same window, --seed 999. Byte-identical across two seeded runs on one machine; the x86/ARM CI matrix may need a looser rtol (in-sample LD from 49 samples is rank-deficient, so the RSS fit is closer to the tolerance edge than the individual-level one). Compared at rtol=1e-4, not 1e-6: the LD is in-sample from 49 samples, so a 200-variant panel has rank <= 48 and the solve sits near-singular, where log-Bayes-factor sums amplify last-bit BLAS differences. Measured macOS-vs-Linux drift 3.5e-6 (logBF) / 5.3e-6 (susieFit lbf_variable) -- bounded rounding, ~20x headroom, still four orders tighter than a real regression (the SuSiE L default change moved this comparison by 0.49 relative).
